description: This Java class defines an Android activity named BigTextMainActivity that extends Activity. Its primary function is to cancel a notification when created and potentially handle reminders from a database. It is part of an Android Wear notification sample project focusing on notification styles.

classes.name: BigTextMainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that handles notification cancellation upon creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created. Sets the layout and cancels a specific notification.
